exposure: formula with prebiotics polydextrose (PDX) and galactooligosaccharides (GOS)
type of feeding (breast milk, formula with prebiotics, formula without prebiotics)
cohort: 157 infants (80 formula-fed, 77 formula with prebiotics, 71 breast-fed)
finding: Adding prebiotics to formula may lead to gut microbiota composition closer to that of breast-fed infants, particularly regarding lactobacilli and S. aureus.
mod_finding: Infants delivered vaginally had different gut microbiota composition compared to a control group, but the abstract does not specify the mode of delivery for the control group.
